description: This file contains serialization, deserialization, copying logic, and surrogate definitions for ConcurrentDictionary<TKey, TValue> in Orleans.Serialization framework. It includes codecs, surrogates, and copiers to facilitate deep copying and serialization of concurrent dictionaries in distributed or persistent scenarios.

classes.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for ConcurrentDictionary that converts to and from a surrogate for serialization purposes.

classes.name: ConcurrentDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A surrogate data structure representing ConcurrentDictionary for serialization.

classes.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Performs deep copying of ConcurrentDictionary instances.

methods.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCodec<Tkey, TValue>.ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a ConcurrentDictionary instance.

methods.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCodec<Tkey, TValue>.ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ConcurrentDictionary into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCopier<Tkey, TValue>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input ConcurrentDictionary.

methods.name: ConcurrentDictionaryCopier<Tkey, TValue>.DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies entries from input to output ConcurrentDictionary.

calls: foreach (var pair in input) => result[ _keyCopier.DeepCopy( pair.Key, context) ] = _valueCopier.DeepCopy( pair.Value, context)
